# appstore-v1_signing_key_list (Data Source)

## Schema

### Optional

- `fields` (String) a comma-separated list of resource fields to fetch/return.  If unspecified, all fields are fetched.  If empty, only key-fields are fetched.
- `filter` (String) an EQL "where" expression that will be used to filter the set of resources returned.
- `label_selector` (String) A label selector string to filter the results based on resource labels. If specified multiple times, the union of resources which satisfy a label-selector will be returned.
- `labelselector` (String) Deprecated: a label selector string to filter the results based on CR labels

<a id="nestedatt--items--spec--public_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spec.public_keys`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Key is the PKIX PEM-encoded public key (e.g. -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----).
- `title` (String) Title optionally identifies this key for status messages and debugging.



<a id="nestedatt--items--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.status`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) Error describes the last validation failure (e.g. which publicKeys entry failed to parse).
- `last_refresh_time` (String) LastRefreshTime is the last time the controller validated spec.publicKeys.
- `loaded` (Boolean) Loaded is true when every entry in spec.publicKeys parsed successfully as a public key.
- `loaded_key_count` (Number) LoadedKeyCount is the number of successfully parsed public keys on the last reconcile.
